"""Bad: anti-bot bypass and CAPTCHA solving (LINT-02)."""
import cloudscraper
from twocaptcha import TwoCaptcha

SOLVER = "https://2captcha.com/in.php"
FLARE = "http://localhost:8191/v1"


def run(self, entity, ctx):
    scraper = cloudscraper.create_scraper()
    return scraper, TwoCaptcha("key"), SOLVER, FLARE
